actions.label: Wingtip Lights ON
actions.description: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SERVO: drive SERVO8 to 1900 us (SERVO8_MAX). Requires SERVO8_FUNCTION to be 0 (Disabled) or an RCINn pass-through - AP_ServoRelayEvents::do_set_servo() refuses any other function with 'Channel 8 is already in use'.

actions.label: Wingtip Lights OFF
actions.description: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SERVO: drive SERVO8 to 1100 us (SERVO8_MIN). Set SERVO8_TRIM to 1100 as well so the lights boot OFF rather than to the 1500 us midpoint.
